map.总帧数 = 时长(s) × 帧率(fps)；跨帧率时长比 = 目标帧率 ÷ 源帧: Total frames = duration (s) × frame rate (fps); cross-rate duration ratio = target fps ÷ source fps (placing 60 fps footage on a 24 fps timeline gives 0.4x slow motion, duration = original duration × 60 ÷ 24); frame drop interval = source fps ÷ target fps; single frame duration = 1 ÷ frame rate (41.67 ms at 24 fps, 16.67 ms at 60 fps).

map.总帧数 = 帧率 × 时长(秒)，按四舍五入取整；换算比 ratio = 目标帧: Total frames = frame rate × duration (seconds), rounded to the nearest integer; the conversion ratio = target frame rate / source frame rate. A ratio above 1 is interpolation (interpolate, playback slows by the ratio), below 1 is frame dropping (drop frames, playback speeds up by 1/ratio), and equal means no conversion is needed.
map.10 秒素材：24fps → 240 帧，60fps → 600 帧。24→60: 10 seconds of footage: 24fps gives 240 frames, 60fps gives 600 frames. Going 24→60 the ratio = 60/24 = 2.5, so every 24 frames must be interpolated to 60 and playback slows 2.5x (slow motion); going 60→24 the ratio = 0.4, and after frame dropping playback speeds up 2.5x.
map.为什么有 23.976 和 29.97 这种小数帧率？: Why are there fractional frame rates such as 23.976 and 29.97?
map.源于 NTSC 彩色电视的实际场频（约 59.94Hz），为兼容而采用 23.9: They come from the actual field rate of NTSC color television (about 59.94Hz), adopted as 23.976/29.97 for compatibility; the difference from 24/30 is only about 0.1%, but over a long film it accumulates into audio and video drift, so conversions must be explicit about it.
map.不能增加真实信息。升帧靠插值生成中间帧，仅让运动更顺滑或实现慢动作；真实细节取决: It cannot add real information. Interpolation generates intermediate frames, only making motion smoother or enabling slow motion; real detail depends on the sample frame rate of the source material.
